recommended_caption: When a tornado warning is issued, go to a basement or small interior room on the lowest floor.

recommended_caption: Check air quality and stay indoors with windows closed when smoke is heavy.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Collapsed multistory building and debris after an earthquake.
recommended_caption: Drop, cover, and hold on until the shaking stops.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Lightning bolt lighting up the night sky over city rooftops.
recommended_caption: When thunder roars, go indoors, and wait 30 minutes after the last thunder.

recommended_alt_text: Car driving through a flooded street after heavy rain.
recommended_caption: Turn around, don't drown. A foot of moving water can float a car.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Emergency supplies laid out on a table, including a first aid kit and water bottles.
recommended_caption: Keep a go-bag ready with water, medicine, copies of documents, a flashlight, and chargers.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Small terrier peeking out of a mesh pet carrier.
recommended_caption: Practice getting pets into carriers before an emergency so evacuation goes faster.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Plumber's hands fitting steel pipes together indoors.
recommended_caption: Call a licensed plumber to find the cause of a sewage backup before using drains again.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Blue flame burning on a gas stove burner.
recommended_caption: If you smell gas, leave right away and call the gas company from outside.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Man in protective gear cutting a tree with a chainsaw in a forest.
recommended_caption: Wear eye, ear, and leg protection, and never cut above shoulder height.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Small group of people talking together in a circle of chairs.
recommended_caption: Talking with others who went through the same disaster can help. Ask 211 about support groups.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Man using a power sander on an interior wall during renovation.
recommended_caption: Wear an N95 mask and eye protection when cutting or sanding drywall.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Large wave crashing over a seaside railing on a stormy day.
recommended_caption: Storm surge can rise many feet in minutes. Evacuate if you're in a surge zone.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Window covered with wooden boards on an old house.
recommended_caption: Cover broken windows with plywood or heavy plastic right away to stop more damage.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Person sorting old black-and-white family photos on a table.
recommended_caption: Rinse wet photos gently in clean water and dry them face up on a towel.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Utility crew working on tangled, fallen power lines along a road.
recommended_caption: Stay at least 35 feet away from downed lines and call the utility or 911.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Firefighter in full gear spraying water from a hose.
recommended_caption: Don't go back inside a burned home until the fire department says it's safe.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Mother and daughter looking at a map together.
recommended_caption: Pick a meeting place near home and one outside your neighborhood, and make sure kids know both.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Black-and-white photo of people waiting at a bus stop.
recommended_caption: Ask your county emergency office now how to get a ride during an evacuation.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Older couple reviewing papers together at a kitchen table.
recommended_caption: Keep a written list of medicines, doctors, and emergency contacts with your go-bag.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Person filling a weekly pill organizer at a table.
recommended_caption: Keep a current medication list so a pharmacy can replace prescriptions quickly.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Assorted cleaning product bottles, sponges, and brushes.
recommended_caption: Never mix bleach with ammonia or other cleaners. The fumes can be deadly.

recommended_alt_text: Worker in a protective suit and respirator standing indoors.
recommended_caption: Homes built before 1980 may have asbestos or lead paint. Hire licensed pros for removal.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Woman sorting receipts and adding expenses on a calculator.
recommended_caption: Keep every receipt for hotel, meals, and mileage while you're displaced.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Woman filling out a form on a clipboard.
recommended_caption: Sign and send the flood proof of loss within your policy's deadline, and keep a copy.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Blue accessibility symbol painted on red brick pavement.
recommended_caption: Ask FEMA for accommodations such as an interpreter, large print, or an accessible meeting place.

recommended_caption: If repairs cost half or more of your home's pre-flood value, local rules may require elevation.
